table hw task text, subject text, due date, done bool
screen soon "Due soon" alarm
  each hw where done = no and due <= today + 1 sort due as h empty "Nothing due soon"
    row card gap 2
      toggle h.done
      h.task bold grow
      h.due faint
screen all "All" list
  each hw where done = no sort due as h empty "All caught up"
    row card gap 2 tap edit h swipe remove h
      toggle h.done
      stack grow
        h.task bold
        h.subject faint
      h.due
  form hw, "Add homework"
screen finished "Done" check
  each hw where done = yes sort at desc as h empty "Nothing finished yet"
    row card gap 2
      toggle h.done
      h.task grow faint
